messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - SolsticeCorp (VPC private) - mass OIDC auth failures observed from their dedicated pool in eu-west-1. > 60% of /v1/infer requests returning 401 / token verification errors. Paging @sam_oncall and @carmen_reliability. Logs: 
`2026-03-15T01:22:11Z auth.go:142 error="jwt: signature is invalid"` and `x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid`. Also several mTLS handshake failures to upstream jwks endpoint.

sam_oncall: Acknowledged. I'm looking at their dedicated pool dashboard now. Can folks avoid making config changes until I confirm impact window? @eva_support can you confirm which customers are affected (prod vs staging) and whether there are any open maintenance windows?

eva_support: Confirmed: only SolsticeCorp prod routes hit the dedicated pool (pool-id: dp-solstice-eu-1). No scheduled maintenance. Customer reports increased 401s starting ~01:20Z. I've opened internal ticket INC-2026-427 and pinged SolsticeCorp SRE alias (sre-solstice@). They've acknowledged and are investigating their IdP.

carmen_reliability: Quick context: we saw similar when a customer's JWKS cert expired — runtime rejects tokens when the JWKS fetch returns 5xx or certs fail validation. Two parallel mitigation paths: 1) short-term: enable fallback to cached JWKS (grace) and allow a configurable grace window for token validation; 2) medium-term: rotate/upload the new cert to the customer's JWKS endpoint or to our customer-specific JWKS mirror in the VPC. I'll coordinate.

minh_platform: I'm on infra. I can flip the fallback to cached JWKS for that pool if we agree. The command to toggle is: ```bash
# enable jwks grace mode for pool
redwoodctl pools update dp-solstice-eu-1 --jwks-grace-window=3600
```

sam_oncall: Do it, @minh_platform - set 3600s grace. That should stop immediate 401 storm and keep customers running while Solstice rotates certs. Keep me posted on error rates, then we'll decide if a rolling restart is needed.

minh_platform: Executed the toggle at 01:30Z. Response from control plane: `OK`

ops-bot: Deploy action: triggered jwks-grace-mode toggle for dp-solstice-eu-1 by minh_platform at 2026-03-15T01:30:12Z. CI run id: ci/rl-9923.

sam_oncall: Observing auth successes rising. 401s have dropped to ~6% from 62% within 8m. Noted some latency spikes (tail p90 -> 450ms) likely due to retry on cached keys.

joe_solutions: I'll prep a short config snippet we can give SolsticeCorp SRE to walk them through uploading a replacement cert to their JWKS endpoint and how to rotate mTLS certs for their dedicated pool. Draft: ```txt
1) Acquire new signing cert (PEM) from IdP.
2) Update jwks at https://idp.solsticecorp.local/.well-known/jwks.json
3) Verify thumbprint matches in VPC mirror config. If mirror not configured, run:
   redwoodctl vpc jwks add --vpc-id vpc-solstice --jwks-url https://idp.solsticecorp.local/.well-known/jwks.json
4) For mTLS cert rotation (dedicated pool):
   redwoodctl certs upload --pool dp-solstice-eu-1 --cert-file solstice-mtls.pem --key-file solstice-mtls.key
```

eva_support: Sending the snippet to SolsticeCorp SRE now (threaded). They say they rotated their IdP cert 12 hours ago but their JWKS caching/proxy failed to refresh. They're chasing internal cache purge.

carmen_reliability: Two follow-ups: 1) We need a temporary tenant-isolation rule to avoid fallback affecting other customers if Solstice's JWKS keeps returning malformed data. I propose enabling grace only on dp-solstice-eu-1 (already targeted) and ensure request-level validation still rejects obviously malformed tokens. 2) Create a short-lived A/B rule to route critical routes to a fallback model variant in the hosted pool if auth continues to fail for any residual requests.

minh_platform: Grace mode is already pool-scoped. I'll add a validation filter to reject tokens that fail schema checks even if signature acceptance is in grace. Deploying filter now (01:44Z).

sam_oncall: Good. @joe_solutions can you stand by to help with a quick script to mirror JWKS into our VPC mirror if Solstice's endpoint remains flaky? We may need to host a copy for them temporarily.

joe_solutions: On it. Mirror script (will need admin keys from Solstice): ```bash
# fetch jwks and push to our mirror
curl -sS https://idp.solsticecorp.local/.well-known/jwks.json -o /tmp/jwks.json
redwoodctl vpc jwks mirror --vpc-id vpc-solstice --src-file /tmp/jwks.json --ttl 3600
```

eva_support: Solstice SRE confirms they purged cache and new JWKS returned with fresh x5c chain. They're going to rotate their mTLS cert for the pool within the hour. ETA 02:15Z.

sam_oncall: Plan: 1) keep jwks-grace=3600 until 02:20Z; 2) have Solstice finish mTLS rotation; 3) validate 10 minutes of green metrics post-rotation; 4) revert grace mode and monitor. If rejections remain, we escalate to on-call infra for rolling restart of dp-solstice-eu-1. Agree?

carmen_reliability: Agree. I'll prepare postmortem checklist and assign owners. Also note: need follow-up to add automated JWKS mirror fallback to our runbook.

minh_platform: I'll schedule the revert at 02:25Z and hold until confirmation.

ops-bot: On-call Handoff: sam_oncall handing off to carmen_reliability for post-rotation monitoring and follow-ups starting 02:05Z.

sam_oncall: Handover notes to @carmen_reliability: current status - jwks-grace=3600 enabled, 401 rate down to 1.2%, Solstice SRE performing mTLS cert rotation, mirror prepared if needed. Escalation path: page infra on-call if 401 > 5% for 5m post-revert.

carmen_reliability: Acknowledged. I'll take 02:05-06:05Z window. @minh_platform hold the revert until I confirm green. Also adding incident tag and P1 timeline to INC-2026-427.

minh_platform: Revert scheduled but paused. Will await Carmen's go.

eva_support: Customer update sent: "We've applied a temporary mitigation; root cause appears to be an expired/mis-published certificate at your IdP. Please complete rotation and confirm. Redwood on-call will monitor and revert temporary grace after you confirm." Solstice replied :thumbsup:.

carmen_reliability: 02:18Z - Solstice reports mTLS cert rotated and JWKS mirror shows updated keys. Running validation tests now.

carmen_reliability: 02:24Z - validation OK. Sampling 2k tokens against new keys: pass rate 99.95%. Reverting jwks-grace to 0 now.

minh_platform: Revert executed at 02:25Z. Control plane response: `OK`.

ops-bot: Action log: jwks-grace reverted for dp-solstice-eu-1 by minh_platform at 2026-03-15T02:25:12Z.

carmen_reliability: Monitoring post-revert metrics: 401s at 0.3%, latency normal. Marking incident as mitigated. I'll open follow-up task: - add JWKS mirror fallback automation - add playbook step for tenant-level grace windows - coordinate with Solstice for postmortem.

sam_oncall: Thanks team. I'll add incident notes and assign postmortem owner to @joe_solutions. Closing outbound pages. :white_check_mark:

joe_solutions: Assigned. I'll schedule RCA and include a timeline, contributing factors (customer IdP cache + no mirror fallback), and action items. Expect draft by EOD.

incident-bot: Incident state changed: P1 -> mitigated. Incident INC-2026-427 will remain open for RCA until 2026-03-18.

carmen_reliability: Final note: We should consider a proactive scan for JWKS TTL anomalies across enterprise VPCs. I'll add to roadmap.
